delivery.outcome: Decompose _build_parser in src/koru/cli_fleet.py into per-subcommand subparser builders (_add_up_subparser, _add_ls_subparser, _add_bootstrap_subparser with _add_bootstrap_scope_arguments/_add_bootstrap_init_arguments, _add_standard_update_subparser, _add_standard_inventory_subparser) so every function stays at or below the code2llm god-function thresholds (fan-out <= 10, mutations <= 6, CC <= 12) while preserving the identical CLI surface: same subcommands, aliases, flags, defaults, types and help strings.
nonGoals: Changing any CLI flag, default, alias, help text or dispatch behaviour
Fixing the pre-existing god functions _add_standard_scope_arguments, _run_fleet_up and _run_fleet_standard_update (separate findings)
Extracting cli_fleet into a new module

architecture.decision: Keep _build_parser as the single composition point that creates the ArgumentParser and subparsers action, and move each subcommand's add_parser/add_argument block into a dedicated module-level helper next to the existing _add_standard_scope_arguments helper.
architecture.rollback: Revert the commit to restore the inline _build_parser implementation.
